headline: HDFC Bank Market Capitalization Crosses ₹12 Lakh Crore After 16% Rally
summary: HDFC Bank shares rallied 16% over four sessions, pushing its market capitalization past ₹12 lakh crore. Trading volumes climbed sharply as the stock outperformed the benchmark.
why: HDFC Bank is India's largest private sector bank, representing a significant weight in domestic and emerging market indices.

impacts.name: HDFC Bank
impacts.why: Heavy buying and volume expansion drive up the company's share price and market capitalization.
